summary: Add a feature-flagged `/reagent-map` route to the ye-olde-magic-shop Vue app showing Aurelis as an offline 3D Cesium globe, with the eight reagent sites from the existing GET /api/reagent-sites endpoint plotted as entities and listed by name beside the globe. The view implements the saturday-playwright-cesium seam contract (`window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__`, `saturdayMetadata` on each site entity) so the sibling test package can drive it. The route and its nav link exist only when the new build-time flag VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is `true`; `.env` keeps it `false` so the app is otherwise unchanged. This is slice 3 of 6 in the reagent-map-spec D1 split — no expeditions, fly-to, line tool, or save behavior, and no backend changes (reagent-sites-api already shipped the endpoint this view consumes).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The /reagent-map route and its nav link exist only when VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is exactly "true"; with it unset, empty, or any other value, there is no route and no link, and the app is otherwise unchanged. .env sets the flag to false.
examples: VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true -> route exists, nav link renders
VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP unset -> no route, no link

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The view runs Cesium with no network dependency: no ion token or ion imagery, baseLayerPicker and geocoder off, one equirectangular image of Aurelis served from the app's own files, Cesium's own static assets served same-origin via CESIUM_BASE_URL, scene mode SCENE3D, and an ellipsoid that is a sphere of radius 6,000 km.
examples: viewer.baseLayerPicker and viewer.geocoder are both false/absent

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The view sets window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ = { viewer, Cesium } and attaches saturdayMetadata { id, name, kind: 'site' } to every reagent site entity, per packages/saturday-playwright-cesium/README.md's seam contract.

Every one of the eight reagent sites is shown within 1 km of its published position and listed by name beside the globe, including Frostcap Hollow near the north pole and Tidewrack Shoals on the 180th meridian, each shown exactly once with no clipping or duplication.
examples: Frostcap Hollow (lat 85, lng 0) appears once, within 1 km of that position
Tidewrack Shoals (lat 0, lng 180) appears once, within 1 km of that position, not duplicated at the antimeridian wrap

acceptanceCriteria.statement: No request made while the reagent map view is open leaves the app's own origin or the mock API's own origin.

A small pure function decides whether the /reagent-map route exists, tested for "true", "false", and unset without a browser. scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh starts the app with VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true so the pre-ship check exercises the view, while .env keeps the flag false. New specs named tests/reagent-map-*.spec.ts run only in the chrome Playwright project; npm run test:e2e (bundled Chromium) still passes without them.

Every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line is covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths changes except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/reagent-map-globe/.

nonFunctionalRequirements.requirement: GET requests, static asset loads, and Cesium's own asset/worker loads triggered by the /reagent-map view MUST NOT leave the app's own origin or the mock API's own origin — no ion imagery, no CDN, no external geocoder.

affectedComponents.reason: New module exporting the pure function isReagentMapEnabled(value: string | undefined): boolean, the small pure predicate the route and nav link both gate on, tested without a browser.

Conditionally append the { path: '/reagent-map', component: ReagentMapView } route only when isReagentMapEnabled(import.meta.env.VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP) is true, so the route genuinely does not exist when the flag is off.
Add a nav <router-link to="/reagent-map"> (data-testid="reagent-map-link") gated by the same isReagentMapEnabled(...) check, alongside the existing Shop/Locations/Cart links.

New API client module: ReagentSite type ({id, name, lat, lng}) and fetchReagentSites(): Promise<ReagentSite[]>, mirroring src/api/items.ts's existing API_BASE/fetch convention against GET /api/reagent-sites.

New view: builds the no-network Cesium Viewer (ellipsoid/globe/imagery config lifted verbatim from packages/saturday-playwright-cesium/fixtures/assets/fixture-globe.js), fetches reagent sites, adds one tagged point entity per site, renders the site-name list beside the globe, exposes window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ on mount and tears it down on unmount (mirroring LocationsView.vue's __SATURDAY_LEAFLET_MAP__ lifecycle pattern).

Set (window as any).CESIUM_BASE_URL = '/cesium/' before mount — inert unless the reagent map route is actually visited, so the app stays unchanged for every other route when the flag is off; keeps Cesium itself out of main.ts's own static imports.

New static asset: a copy of the already-reviewed, same-origin equirectangular Aurelis texture at packages/saturday-playwright-cesium/fixtures/assets/aurelis.jpg (1024x512px). Do not regenerate it — copy the existing, reviewed file.

Add "cesium": "1.146.0" (exact version, no caret range) to dependencies, matching packages/saturday-playwright-cesium/package.json and the version already resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml — avoids a second resolved Cesium version in the lockfile.

Add a small inline dev-server/build plugin that serves node_modules/cesium/Build/Cesium under /cesium/ in dev (configureServer) and copies the same directory into the build's outDir/cesium on build (closeBundle/writeBundle) — no new dependency, and no write into public/ or need for a new .gitignore entry (dist/ is already ignored; .gitignore is not in scope.paths).

Add a testIgnore for the reagent-map-*.spec.ts glob on the 'chromium' project only, so npm run test:e2e/test:pw stay unaffected; the 'chrome' project picks the new specs up with no change needed on its side.
Add VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=false, keeping the flag off for every normal local run.

start_app_and_mock_api() must export VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true to the containerized npm run dev process, so the pre-ship chrome-project run exercises the view while every other invocation keeps the flag at .env's false.
New test: isReagentMapEnabled('true')===true, isReagentMapEnabled('false')===false, isReagentMapEnabled(undefined)===false — no page fixture, no browser launched.

New chrome-project test using @orieken/saturday-playwright-cesium's cesium fixture: asserts the seam contract, all 8 sites within 1 km (including the pole/antimeridian cases), SCENE3D, the 6,000 km ellipsoid, and zero off-origin requests.

architecturalFlags: First VITE_FEATURE_* flag convention in this app. It is a single pure boolean-returning function with no new abstraction layer or cross-cutting mechanism (no flag service, no remote config) — recommend skipping architect for this reason, consistent with CLAUDE.md's guidance to skip architect for features purely additive within an established pattern. Flagging for the router to confirm.

Static-asset serving for Cesium (CESIUM_BASE_URL) has no existing precedent in this monorepo's apps — this order introduces a small inline Vite plugin in vite.config.ts rather than a new build-tool dependency, specifically because apps/ye-olde-magic-shop's scope.paths excludes .gitignore and index.html, which rules out the two more common approaches (committing generated assets under public/, or a static <script> tag in index.html). Worth a second look from whoever reviews vite.config.ts.

edgeCases.case: VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is set to a near-true value such as "TRUE", "1", or " true" (whitespace/case variants).
edgeCases.handling: isReagentMapEnabled uses strict equality against the literal string 'true' — any other value, including case or whitespace variants, is treated as off. This is deliberate and exactly what the pure-function unit test must cover for 'false' and 'unset'; no normalization is added.

edgeCases.case: A reagent site's seeded longitude is exactly 180 (Tidewrack Shoals) or latitude is near 90 (Frostcap Hollow, lat 85).
edgeCases.handling: Cesium.Cartesian3.fromDegrees handles the antimeridian and near-pole cases natively when given the correct ellipsoid; the fixture-globe.js pattern already proves this renders once, not duplicated — no special-casing is added in the view beyond passing the ellipsoid through.

edgeCases.case: GET /api/reagent-sites is slow, fails, or the mock API is not running.
edgeCases.handling: fetchReagentSites() follows items.ts's existing convention: throw on a non-OK response. The view should let the error surface (e.g. an unhandled rejection becomes visible in dev) rather than silently showing an empty globe — no new retry or fallback logic is introduced, consistent with architecture-guardrails.md's prohibition on ad-hoc retry loops; a real CircuitBreaker is out of scope for a single same-origin GET with no stated latency SLA.

edgeCases.case: The flag is true but the Cesium static assets at /cesium/ are missing or stale (e.g. a build that forgot the closeBundle copy step).
edgeCases.handling: Cesium's worker bootstrap fails fast with its own console error when CESIUM_BASE_URL assets are absent; this is a build-configuration defect to catch via the QA chrome-project run (cesium.waitForSettled() will reject naming the stuck condition), not a runtime fallback the app needs to handle gracefully.

edgeCases.case: A developer navigates directly to /reagent-map via URL while the flag is off.
edgeCases.handling: Because the route object itself is never added to the router when the flag is off (not merely hidden via a guard), vue-router falls through to its normal unmatched-route behavior — identical to typing any other nonexistent path today. No new 404 view is introduced.

definitionOfDone: /reagent-map route and its nav link exist if and only if VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP is the literal string 'true'; apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/.env sets it to false.

The view's Cesium Viewer uses a 6,000,000m-radius ellipsoid, scene mode SCENE3D, baseLayerPicker/geocoder off, a same-origin equirectangular Aurelis image, and same-origin Cesium static assets served via CESIUM_BASE_URL — with zero network requests leaving the app's or mock API's own origin.
window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ = { viewer, Cesium } is set, and every one of the 8 reagent site entities carries saturdayMetadata { id, name, kind: 'site' }.
All 8 reagent sites, including Frostcap Hollow and Tidewrack Shoals, are shown exactly once, each within 1 km of its published position, and listed by name beside the globe.
isReagentMapEnabled is covered by a no-browser unit test for 'true', 'false', and unset.

tests/reagent-map-*.spec.ts run only under the Playwright 'chrome' project; npm run test:e2e passes unaffected by their presence; scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh starts the container with the flag on and its chrome-project run passes.
Every new/changed function is reviewed for cyclomatic complexity below 7 (judgment-only — no ESLint complexity rule exists yet in apps/ye-olde-magic-shop).
git diff shows no file changed outside scope.paths, excepting docs/features/reagent-map-globe/**.
